transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. Today we need to lock down the Q3 Stripe Billing integration and solve the webhook latency spikes we noticed on staging.
From our side, our enterprise pilot starts October 1st. If the payment API isn't reliable and compliant by next week, we risk delaying 4 major pilot accounts.
I looked at the webhook failure logs this morning. It's an idempotent lock contention on PostgreSQL connection pooling under concurrent retry bursts.
Raj, can you commit to refactoring the Redis distributed lock and verifying end-to-end sandbox payments before the Friday code freeze?
Yes, I will complete the payment API refactor and push the idempotency fixes to staging by Friday at 5 PM EST.
That sounds great. What about the SOC2 compliance export documentation our compliance team requested?
I have the audit logs parsed. I'll finalize and email the signed SOC2 Type II audit package directly to Sarah by tomorrow afternoon.
Decision agreed: we will use PostgreSQL 16 read replicas with Supabase connection pooler to eliminate webhook connection exhaustion.
Wait, on last week's sync on September 12, Raj had initially mentioned delivery for Friday, but if there's any regression testing needed, could Monday work?
Actually, to ensure thorough soak testing over the weekend with automated load tests, let's officially adjust delivery: Staging deployment on Friday, production sign-off moved to Monday morning.
Agreed. Who is responsible for setting up the Datadog APM dashboard for latency monitoring?
We definitely need visibility into p99 response times before the pilot starts.

report.executiveSummary: Executive alignment session. Evaluated peak-load webhook retry contention and connection exhaustion on PostgreSQL. Reached consensus to provision PostgreSQL 16 read replicas with Supabase connection pooling. Person C (Raj Patel) committed to completing the payment API refactoring and staging deployment by Friday at 5:00 PM EST, with production sign-off scheduled for Monday morning following automated soak tests. Person D (Elena Rostova) committed to finalizing and delivering the signed SOC2 Type II compliance audit package to Person B (Sarah Chen) by tomorrow afternoon.
